blind.description: A modular set of masonry stairs constructed from dressed brownish-grey rectangular stone blocks. The model features a lower flight of steps leading up to an intermediate landing, which turns into an upper parallel flight ascending higher. The side and rear walls are solid vertical stone masonry, and the entire structure rests flat on the ground with clean, solid geometry and no floating or melted parts.
blind.from_above: An offset, staggered arrangement of two parallel rectangular flights of steps linked in the middle by a square-shaped landing platform.
blind.height_vs_figure: The tallest step is roughly shoulder-to-head height of the figure (around 5 to 6 ft tall), spanning about 5 to 6 ft in length and about 2.5 to 3 ft in width.

problems: Flights are parallel rather than at a right angle (not L-shaped)
Footprint is rectangular (10.0 x 4.5 ft) instead of roughly square (10.0 x 10.0 ft)
